title: Deterministic CBOR on encode
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR; Reference generation script generate_dvc_qr.py; RFC 8949 CBOR (obsoletes RFC 7049).

statements.label: Deterministic CBOR on encode
statements.requirement: The encoder SHALL produce deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 section 4.2.1 core deterministic encoding). For the HCERT key sets this matches the RFC 7049 canonical ordering the reference script uses. Same input gives same bytes, in both languages.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-CBR-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-CBR-001 maps are encoded in deterministic key order, whatever order they were built in` (EncodeCborTest.kt); `STT-TST-002 STT-CBR-001 deterministic re-encoding reproduces the issued CWT byte for byte` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt)).
